roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.mission: The core mission of the Software Engineer is to deliver high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code while collaborating with the team to ensure timely delivery of features and smooth product performance.
roles.summary: Key role in Engineering driving technical delivery, quality, and stakeholder value.
accountabilities: The core mission of the Software Engineer is to deliver high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code while collaborating with the team to ensure timely delivery of features and smooth product performance.

Write and review code with a focus on quality, performance, and maintainability. - Apply feedback from peers and mentors; proactively raise risks and limitations early. - Participate actively in grooming, standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. - Maintain Jira hygiene (impact areas, test cases, sub-tasks logged). - Contribute to “lunch-and-learn” sessions and knowledge sharing within the team. - Adhere to branching, CI/CD, and other defined engineering processes.
responsibilities: Key Competencies of the Role
Proficiency in programming languages, frameworks, and tools used by the team.
Agile/Scrum methodology understanding.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
Test-driven development.
Smart use of AI Productivity tools like Github Copilot
Clear and structured communication skills. Maintains well in time communication.
